files.basis: New file provenance tooling authored for the 2026-09-27 migration goal; uses Node built-ins and Git metadata, no copied upstream implementation. The 2026-09-28 extension adds digest-bound, non-authorizing retained-nature reviews, accepted-only overlapping statistics and one evidenced host-manifest alias; it preserves upstream and third-party facts and existing conflict/expiry rules. New requirements were tested before implementation.

Node runtime facilities remain third-party dependencies; other host modules are not reclassified.

Independent execution-lifetime design gives each cell ownership of its revocable Session bridges, each worker one completion arbiter, and each process one output supervisor. The public executor fields, worker kind, event names, default roots and diagnostics remain interoperability constraints. Eighteen black-box groups ran against the former implementation: fifteen passed; interceptable worker cancellation and two unprintable-error paths failed. All pass after replacement, including retained bridge revocation. Actual built MCP verifies fresh VM globals/module caches, deadline recovery, opaque error containment and one output-close callback. Source access is disclosed; this is not a no-access clean-room claim. Generic platform APIs and retained contract declarations do not alone establish originality; ownership/control design, tests and reviewed boundaries support this limited decision. MCP scheduling, platform plugin loading and remaining product code are not included.

The dispatch design uses one explicit FIFO owner per normalized session, a separate promise-only completion registry and shared close barrier, and a stdio instance owner. Eighteen public behavior groups ran against the prior server: eleven passed and seven exposed unscoped-key collision, premature or incomplete closure, late success, and skipped cleanup. The independent scheduling/lifecycle composition passes those groups and four stdio ownership/reentrant-construction groups plus two structured error cancellation groups. Review found and reproduced a constructor-close leak and loss of explicit/fallback isError diagnostics in the initial design; tests failed before the targeted corrections and now pass. Actual built MCP checks serial/concurrent routing and closed discovery, while the unchanged stable executable URL still starts real isolated workers. Argument fields, schema constraints, exported names, environment names, protocol text and external SDK calls are retained interoperability requirements; those facts alone do not prove originality. Source access is disclosed and this is not a no-access clean-room claim. Third-party MCP/Zod and the remaining plugin loader, core, desktop and UI are outside this limited license decision.
